title: Pottery Wheel - Beginner
description: Learn the basics of wheel throwing and create your first ceramic mug
longDescription: Discover the joy of shaping clay on the pottery wheel in this beginner friendly one-on-one workshop. You'll learn the basics of wheel throwing whilst creating your first ever ceramic mug or bowl in a relaxing and supportive environment.
requirements: Private class with no experience needed.

title: Pottery Wheel - Intermediate
description: Already learnt the basics? Have a go at our intermediate workshop to further improve your skills
longDescription: Build confidence with the wheel and develop more advanced throwing techniques in this one-on-one workshop. Refine your centering, shape more complex forms and feel more in control of your future projects.
requirements: Private class with basic experience with the wheel recommended.

title: Throw and Decorate
description: Discover throwing techniques and explore ways to personalise your piece, all in one session
longDescription: Go further with your imagination and personalise your piece straight after throwing it. Whether you're a first time potter or have prior experience, this workshop gives you an opportunity to express yourself through one of the following decorative techniques:
requirements: Private class with no experience needed.

title: Kids & Parents Ceramic Class
description: Weekly after school ceramics class for both kids and parents
longDescription: Let your children's (and your own!) imagination flow at our weekly ceramics class. Perfect for families and for those seeking a weekly activity. Register your intertest and let me know which time and day works best for you, and we can try to make it happen!
requirements: Join a group session in our beautiful studio in Penela where your teacher will guide you through the basics of handbuilding pottery. No experience needed.

title: Kids Ceramic Class
description: Weekly after school ceramics class for kids
longDescription: Let your children's imagination flow at our weekly ceramics class. Perfect for those seeking an after school activity for their children. Here they will have the freedom to channel their energy and the guidance necessary to to create their own ceramic masterpiece. channel their energy in this weekly activity. Register your intertest and let me know which time and day works best for you.
requirements: Join a group session in our beautiful studio in Penela where your teacher will guide you through the basics of handbuilding pottery. No experience needed.
